seo_title: B2B Software Rescue: Legacy Code Audit & Refactoring
seo_desc: Did your developer disappear leaving your system as a black box? We audit, document, and rescue your B2B legacy code so you can scale safely again.
author_pitch: As a Software Architect, I have seen entire companies tremble because the only programmer who understood their custom ERP quit. My specialty is entering those black boxes of undocumented code, applying reverse engineering, and rescuing your orphaned system to give you back absolute control of your technology.
title: The orphan software syndrome: Rescue your custom system from the black box
body:
Have you invested thousands of dollars in custom software and now the original developer has disappeared, leaving you with a locked system that nobody knows how to update?

In the B2B sector, it is common to commission the development of an ERP or dashboard to an agency or freelance developer who, over time, abandons the project. You are left with what engineers call "orphan software": undocumented code, full of patches and obsolete dependencies. Every time you try to hire a new technical team to add a feature or fix a critical bug, they tell you the system is an incomprehensible mess and the only way out is to trash your entire investment and start from scratch. This dependency on a single person (Bus Factor) holds your company's operations hostage and completely blocks your scalability.

The trap of Rewriting Everything From Scratch

When new developers see complex foreign code, their instinct is always to ask you for an astronomical budget to remake the entire system, arguing that it will be safer. Throwing away years of validated business logic out of fear of reading old code is a luxury no B2B company should pay for.

Our solution: Reverse Engineering and Legacy Code Refactoring

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we are not afraid of complex code. As software architecture specialists, we act as a technical SWAT team. We enter your server, unravel the hidden logic through reverse engineering, and sanitize the foundations of your platform so it becomes secure, documented, and scalable again.

  1. Forensic Code Audit: We map the entire current architecture, identifying database bottlenecks, critical security vulnerabilities, and obsolete third-party dependencies.
  2. Reverse Engineering and Documentation: We translate the unreadable code into flowcharts and standardized technical documentation, giving you back the real intellectual property of your tool.
  3. Continuous Surgical Refactoring: We clean and optimize the codebase module by module, eliminating technical debt without interrupting your company's daily operations.
  4. Automated Testing Implementation: We build a shield of automatic tests around your critical functionalities to ensure that future updates never break the system.

The Real Impact on your Technological Ownership

  • Business Control Recovery: You stop being held hostage by a single programmer; by having documented and standardized code, any technical team will be able to scale your system.
  • Massive Capital Savings: You rescue and make profitable the original investment of tens of thousands of dollars you already made in your software, avoiding having to finance a development from scratch.
  • B2B Innovation Unlocked: Your custom platform becomes agile and secure again, allowing you to launch new features to the market and connect with modern APIs without fear of crashes.
